name: AVCI_FINAL_TEST_PRIMARY_HYPOTHESIS_V1
primary_hypothesis: In BTC-DOWN episodes, frozen Avci candidates outperform same-scan matched controls on conditional-BTC-beta-residual, cost-stressed fixed-exit net return.
unit_of_inference: 72h overlapping market episode, not individual coin event
primary_comparison: candidate minus same-scan matched-control fixed-exit return
primary_adjustments: pre-signal conditional BTC beta residualization where data coverage is sufficient
primary_success_rule: Episode-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of matched candidate-control mean difference is greater than 0.
minimum_interpretability: matching coverage and covariate balance must be reported
no threshold or rule changes from FINAL_TEST outcomes
secondary_diagnostics: MFE and MAE normalized by realized volatility when available
candidate/control hit rates as descriptive only
non_goals: FINAL_TEST is not used to retune frozen v1/V5
MFE touch rate is not the primary success metric
Telegram scorecards are not selection criteria
canonical_role: This file is the single confirmatory hypothesis contract for the 2026-10-07 prospective holdout. Other targets/horizons are secondary unless explicitly listed here.

engine_scope.binance: Confirmatory only where the required BTC-DOWN, same-scan matched-control, residual and execution-stress evidence exists.
engine_scope.gate: Reported separately; it may not substitute for the primary hypothesis unless a future prospective version pre-registers a Gate-specific primary hypothesis.
engine_scope.new_launch: Exploratory/observational only; excluded from this confirmatory claim.

primary_endpoint.return_definition: fixed-exit net return after 2x transaction-cost stress, residualized for pre-signal conditional BTC beta where coverage is sufficient
primary_endpoint.success_rule: episode-cluster bootstrap lower confidence bound > 0 under the registered sequential alpha rule

secondary_only: +3/+5/+7/+10/+15 barrier hit rates and hit times
Gate weighted discovery and New Launch

sequential_testing.checkpoint_50: diagnostic only; cannot authorize tiny-live review
sequential_testing.multiplicity_rule: three-look Bonferroni within the primary family
sequential_testing.activation_note: Statistical success alone never authorizes live trading; all governance/execution/data-quality gates remain required.

execution_evidence.rule: Quote-observed cost is never called realized cost. Missing realized fills remain missing.
execution_evidence.primary_reporting: Report evidence-grade coverage beside the primary result.

data_failure_sensitivity.rule: Report primary result and a pessimistic sensitivity treating unresolved/data-failure candidate outcomes as stop/loss.
data_failure_sensitivity.tiny_live_block: If pessimistic candidate-control expectancy is <= 0, tiny-live review is blocked.

metric_clarifications.event_series_sharpe_sortino: Diagnostic only; sqrt(365) event-series annualization cannot substitute for a time-normalized portfolio Sharpe/Sortino.
metric_clarifications.timeout_expectancy: Timeout returns remain in the return series; expectancy is not computed only from win/loss classes.
metric_clarifications.mae: Diagnostic adverse excursion should be floored at zero when the path never moves adversely.

no_post_start_edits: After 2026-10-07T00:00:00Z, any semantic change requires a new prospective version/cohort.
